plugins.name: human-resources
plugins.description: Streamline people operations — recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation analysis, and policy guidance. Maintain compliance and keep your team running smoothly.

skills.name: comp-analysis
skills.description: Analyze compensation — benchmarking, band placement, and equity modeling. Trigger with "what should we pay a [role]", "is this offer competitive", "model this equity grant", or when uploading comp data to find outliers and retention risks.
skills.description_zh: 分析薪酬基准、薪级带位置与股权方案，判断岗位或录用报价的竞争力，并从薪酬数据识别异常与人员留存风险。

skills.name: draft-offer
skills.description: Draft an offer letter with comp details and terms. Use when a candidate is ready for an offer, assembling a total comp package (base, equity, signing bonus), writing the offer letter text itself, or prepping negotiation guidance for the hiring manager.
skills.description_zh: 起草包含薪酬与条款的录用通知，组合基本工资、股权和签约奖金等总薪酬方案，并为招聘经理准备谈判建议。

skills.name: interview-prep
skills.description: Create structured interview plans with competency-based questions and scorecards. Trigger with "interview plan for", "interview questions for", "how should we interview", "scorecard for", or when the user is preparing to interview candidates.
skills.description_zh: 为候选人面试制定结构化计划，设计基于能力的问题与评分表，支持面试准备和评价标准制定。

skills.name: onboarding
skills.description: Generate an onboarding checklist and first-week plan for a new hire. Use when someone has a start date coming up, building the pre-start task list (accounts, equipment, buddy), scheduling Day 1 and Week 1, or setting 30/60/90-day goals for a new team member.
skills.description_zh: 生成新员工入职清单及首周计划，安排入职前账号、设备、伙伴等事项，设计首日首周日程与30/60/90天目标。

skills.name: org-planning
skills.description: Headcount planning, org design, and team structure optimization. Trigger with "org planning", "headcount plan", "team structure", "reorg", "who should we hire next", or when the user is thinking about team size, reporting structure, or organizational design.
skills.description_zh: 开展人员编制规划、组织设计和团队结构优化，支持团队规模、汇报关系、重组及下一步招聘岗位的讨论。

skills.name: people-report
skills.description: Generate headcount, attrition, diversity, or org health reports. Use when pulling a headcount snapshot for leadership, analyzing turnover trends by team, preparing diversity representation metrics, or assessing span of control and flight risk across the org.
skills.description_zh: 生成员工人数、流失、多样性及组织健康报告，支持领导人数快照、分团队离职趋势、多样性代表指标、管理幅度与离职风险评估。

skills.name: performance-review
skills.description: Structure a performance review with self-assessment, manager template, and calibration prep. Use when review season kicks off and you need a self-assessment template, writing a manager review for a direct report, prepping rating distributions and promotion cases for calibration, or turning vague feedback into specific behavioral examples.
skills.description_zh: 组织绩效评审，提供自评和经理评审模板，准备评级分布及晋升案例的校准材料，并把笼统反馈转为具体行为实例。

skills.name: policy-lookup
skills.description: Find and explain company policies in plain language. Trigger with "what's our PTO policy", "can I work remotely from another country", "how do expenses work", or any plain-language question about benefits, travel, leave, or handbook rules.
skills.description_zh: 查找并用通俗语言解释公司政策，回答福利、差旅、休假、费用报销、跨国远程工作及员工手册规则等问题。

skills.name: recruiting-pipeline
skills.description: Track and manage recruiting pipeline stages. Trigger with "recruiting update", "candidate pipeline", "how many candidates", "hiring status", or when the user discusses sourcing, screening, interviewing, or extending offers.
